paragraphs: Rav Shila bar Avimi. See the entry R' Shila bar Avina.[^1]

notes.text: Avimi (אבימי) and Avina (אבינא) remain different supplied patronymics. The heading explicitly writes Rav; the target’s abbreviated title remains R' rather than taking its expansion from the heading.
